generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
The Manual submission of bids or documents is prohibited and such submissions shall be ignored and bid of a bidder making such submissions is liable to be rejected as disqualified.

Tenders must be correctly and properly uploaded in KPP Portal (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in) on or before the time and date specified in the KPP portal and Technical Bid of the Tenders will be opened on the specified date and time in the presence of the Tenderers who wish to attend. If the office happens to be closed on the any specified date of the tenders, the said action shall be taken on the next working day at the same time and venue.
Other details are available in the bidding documents.

The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP on or before the last date of bid submission. The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for in-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Firms Conditional tenders are not accepted.
The cost of the Tender processing fees shall not be refundable.
Acceptance/Cancellation of the tender are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.

As per Karnatka State Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare Fund.

The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP Portal.The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of their tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
All Tender Conditions as per Bid documents / TOR.

The technical Evaluation format which is attached as data sheet in General and Technical specifications, Concept Note, Design, Data sheet & Etc. which has to be filled by the bidder for all the items to qualify technically.
The materials Quality control certificates from the authorized quality control laboratories to be provided by the contractor before using the materials.
Quality control certificate issued from the QC authority must accompanied with bill.

The work should be executed strictly as per the tender specification mentioned. Contractor should arrange for quality check at different stage of work for quality assurance as per direction of Engineer-in-charge during the work in progress and after completion.
Acceptance and cancellation of the tender are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
All the items in the tender are inclusive of cost and conveyance of all materials, all lead, lift, loading, unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery, curing for concrete works.
Materials like cement aggregate sand etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority before used on the work.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Operation & Maintenance of Multi Village Water Supply Scheme to Chakenahalli & Other 23villages of Holenarsipura Taluk in Hassan District.(O & M for 05 years).

itemList.description:
OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE for 1st Year to 5th Year : Operation and maintenance of the scheme as per TOR which includes providing sufficient technical staff valve man, watchman, operations electrician and others who are required to run system in complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required for operation for operation of raw water pumping machinary & pumping machinary at WTP also pumping machinary at intermediate sump to villages , jack wells /WTP/Pipe line repaire works 1.Regular maintenance of civil structures like jack well , raw water balancing tank , RSF/SSF, pure water house MBT& exiting in village OHT and all other civil structure. The maintenance consist of all kinds of repair to damaged structure cleaning & washing and painting for civil structure . All the infrastructure must be maintained in good working condition through out the year and replacement of damage pipeline valves etc. if found necessary it includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring systems the maintainance involes Raw water raising mains,pure raising main ,maintaining the requird discharge the quatom of water in each pipe . 2. Operation and maintenance WTP it including dosing of required quantity of alum cloring and requireed necessary chemicals including replacement of sand/filter media as reuired as per standard of establishednorms from time to time maintaining the quality of water as per guidelines CPHEEO manual ISI specification including cost of testing of water at laboratory twice in a month. 3.Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery other chemical components of the scheme including electricalmaintainance coveing all repairs relacement of eletrical cable/switch board . Replacement of all parts of machinery will be carried out as per the direction of the engineer incharge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide the designed dis charge of drinking water to all the habitants of the project.
The bidder shall quote for the 5year O & M cost against the total estimated cost of Rs.3,00,96,514.00 The year wise breakup amount shall be calculated as the percentage given below.  
Year 1: 18.10%  
Year 2: 19.00%
Year 3: 19.95%
Year 4: 20.95%
Year 5: 22.00%
